requirement: The system shall refuse to issue a ticket when the requested service has no remaining seats available for the selected departure.
The system shall compute the ticket fare as the base fare for the journey plus any seat class supplement and booking fee, applying the concession rate if applicable.
The passenger selects a service and journey, confirms payment; the system issues a ticket and returns the ticket reference and QR code.
The passenger presents their QR code at the barrier; the system validates the ticket, opens the barrier and marks the ticket as used for that departure.
As a passenger, I want to view my upcoming journeys and tickets so that I have them ready when travelling.
As a transport operator, I want to open and close ticket sales for a service so that passengers can only buy while the service is on sale.
A ticket may only be refunded if the departure is more than two hours away and the fare class is refundable.
Every ticket purchase, cancellation, refund and gate validation must be recorded with the passenger, the ticket, the amount and the time.
The ticket table shall ensure that a ticket has a unique reference, a positive fare and a status from the recognised set.

-- public transport ticket table
CREATE TABLE ticket (
    ticket_id        BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ticket_reference VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    passenger_id     VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    departure_id     VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    seat_class       VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    fare_class       VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    fare_amount      NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    status           VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    issued_at        TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ticket_reference_unique UNIQUE (ticket_reference),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_fare_positive    CHECK (fare_amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_status_chk       CHECK (status IN ('ISSUED','USED','CANCELLED','REFUNDED','EXPIRED')),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_seat_class_chk   CHECK (seat_class IN ('STANDARD','FIRST','SLEEPER')),
    CONSTRAINT ticket_fare_class_chk   CHECK (fare_class IN ('STANDARD','CONCESSION','CHILD'))
);

CREATE INDEX ticket_passenger_idx ON ticket (passenger_id, issued_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX ticket_departure_idx ON ticket (departure_id, status);

-- departure master table
CREATE TABLE departure (
    departure_id   VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    route_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    departs_at     TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    sales_cutoff   TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    sales_state    VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT departure_sales_cutoff_order CHECK (sales_cutoff <= departs_at),
    CONSTRAINT departure_sales_state_chk  CHECK (sales_state IN ('OPEN','CLOSED','SUSPENDED'))
);
-- seat allocation by departure and class
CREATE TABLE seat_allocation (
    allocation_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    departure_id   VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    seat_class     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    capacity       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    sold           INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT alloc_departure_fk FOREIGN KEY (departure_id) REFERENCES departure(departure_id),
    CONSTRAINT alloc_unique UNIQUE (departure_id, seat_class),
    CONSTRAINT alloc_sold_range CHECK (sold BETWEEN 0 AND capacity)
);

requirement: Only the ticketing agent who issued the ticket may cancel it at the counter; passengers must use the app for self-service cancellation.
The daily reconciliation report shall show, for each route, the number of tickets issued, tickets used, total fare collected and refunds paid.
